run_test_module: run a Python test module by name using subprocess and return whether it passed
find_test_files: find all test files ending in test.py within a given directory tree
convert_path_to_module: convert a file path like ./dir/file.py into a dotted module name string
run_all_tests_in_dir: run all test files in a directory as separate subprocesses and exit with success or failure
exclude_build_dirs: exclude build, tox, and venv directories when walking a directory tree for test files
